body.intent: Fix When a PR's merge is refused because origin/main moved past the checked head, or GitHub reports a conflict, the ship-change merge step hands the whole change set back to the conductor (a rejoin) instead of rebasing in the ship steps themselves: in milestone 38 every PR (#588, #590, #591, #593) took an extra conductor visit, gate and CI round for a clean rebase. Rebase (rhiza ship rebase) and re-check in the ship steps when the merge of main is clean, and hand back only on a real conflict
